title: The Finish

body:
For all the physical conditioning required for an athlete to excel in competition, mental preparation is just as vital. A weightlifter stares hard at the hundreds of pounds he or she is about to lift off the floor, envisioning it hoisted in the air. A diver stands poised on the high board, mentally reviewing every twist and tuck to be executed before hitting the water. A marathoner looks past the pain to see the finish line down the road.

In every case, the competitor must struggle to overcome personal limitations. No victory is guaranteed. Imagine if the outcome were guaranteed, despite the intervening challenges.

By one sacrifice he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy (Hebrews 10:14).

What a wonderful promise to every believer. Christ has guaranteed our finish. Yes, the process of “being made holy” is often difficult. Believers struggle against temptation, endure sorrow, and live with the many varieties of pain in a fallen world. However, from Jesus’ perspective, He has already “made perfect forever” every person who trusts in Him.

PRAYER SUGGESTION:

Ask God to increase your awareness of all that Jesus has done for you through His sacrifice.
